value.rationale: The full graphic-matroid independent-set indicator of K6 is a classical natural forest family. It exhibits the first singular convolution after three invertible orders (n=3,4,5) and has a complete ten-orbit cancellation classification with a unique minimal paw-plus-edge shape. Exact rank, sharp inverse spectral gap and sharp L1/L∞ Fourier range projection amplification (605029/16384) are naturally required for concrete deconvolution/stability benchmarks; not a gratuitous normalization or an arbitrary random finite slice. A finite exact classification is the intended mathematical contribution, not a claim of a general K_n theorem.
